title: Ishga kirish suhbati
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ish suhbatida o‘zingizni 3 qismda tanishtirasiz, kuchli tomon va tajribangizni misol bilan tasvirlaysiz, rasmiy uslubda gapirasiz va suhbatchiga muloyim savollar berasiz.

scenes.title: Ishga kirish suhbati: xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum, xush kelibsiz! Oldingi darsda fikr bildirishni va uni sabab hamda misol bilan asoslashni o‘rgandik. Bugun shu ko‘nikmani juda muhim vaziyatda qo‘llaymiz: ishga kirish suhbati. Dars oxirida o‘zingizni tanishtirasiz, kuchli tomonlaringiz va tajribangizni aniq tasvirlaysiz, rasmiy uslubda gapirasiz va suhbat oxirida o‘zingiz ham savol berasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Today we are practising for a job interview. By the end, you will be able to introduce yourself, talk about your strengths and experience, and ask good questions.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz! Bugun ish suhbatiga tayyorlanamiz. Dars oxirida o‘zingizni tanishtirasiz, kuchli tomonlaringiz va tajribangiz haqida gapirasiz va yaxshi savollar berasiz.

scenes.title: Suhbat qanday o‘tadi
scenes.say_native: Ko‘pchilik ingliz tilidagi suhbatlar bir xil tartibda o‘tadi. Avval salomlashish va qisqa suhbat: “Thank you for coming”. Keyin sizning o‘zingiz haqingizdagi savollar, ish bo‘yicha savollar, so‘ng sizning savollaringiz va xayrlashuv. Tartibni bilsangiz, nimaga tayyor turishni bilasiz va xotirjam bo‘lasiz. Bugun har bir bosqichni o‘rganamiz, ayniqsa o‘zingiz haqingizda gapirish va savol berish qismlarini.
scenes.say: A job interview usually follows the same order. First, greetings. Then questions about you and the job. Then it is your turn to ask questions. Finally, you say thank you.
scenes.say_uz: Ish suhbati odatda bir xil tartibda o‘tadi. Avval salomlashish. Keyin siz va ish haqidagi savollar. Keyin sizning savol berish navbatingiz. Oxirida rahmat aytasiz.

scenes.title: Tell me about yourself

examples.t: I'm an accountant with three years of experience.
I studied economics at the university in Tashkent.
I'm now looking for a more challenging role.

scenes.say_native: Eng birinchi savol deyarli doim shu: “Tell me about yourself”. Bu hayot hikoyangizni so‘rash emas. Qisqa, uch qismli javob bering: hozirgi holatingiz, o‘tgan tajribangiz va kelajak maqsadingiz. Masalan: “I’m an accountant with three years of experience. I studied economics in Tashkent. Now I’m looking for a more challenging role.” Yarim daqiqa yetadi. Ish bilan bog‘liq narsalarni ayting, oilangiz haqida emas.
scenes.say: When they say, tell me about yourself, use three parts: present, past and future. I'm an accountant with three years of experience. I studied economics in Tashkent. Now I'm looking for a more challenging role.
scenes.say_uz: Tell me about yourself deyilsa, uch qismdan foydalaning: hozir, o‘tmish va kelajak. Men uch yillik tajribali buxgalterman. Toshkentda iqtisodiyot o‘qiganman. Hozir murakkabroq lavozim qidiryapman.

scenes.title: O‘zingizni tanishtirishdagi xatolar
board: ✗ My name is Ali. I am 25 years old. I like football.
✓ I'm a graduate in… with experience in…
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: javobni ism, yosh va sevimli mashg‘ulot bilan cheklash. Ish beruvchi sizdan kasbiy ma’lumot kutadi: nimani o‘qigansiz, qayerda ishlagansiz, nimaga qodirsiz. Ikkinchisi: “good in English”. O‘zbekchada “inglizchada yaxshi” deymiz, shuning uchun “in” ishlatamiz, ammo to‘g‘risi “good at”. Xuddi shuningdek, “experience in” yoki “experience of” ham ishlatiladi, lekin “good at” ga o‘zgarmaydi.
scenes.say: Don't only give your name, age and hobbies. Talk about your studies and work. And say good at, not good in. I'm good at English.
scenes.say_uz: Faqat ism, yosh va sevgan mashg‘ulotni aytmang. Ta’lim va ish haqida gapiring. Good at deng, good in emas. Men inglizchada yaxshiman.

scenes.title: O‘zingizni tanishtiring
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingizni 3 gap bilan tanishtiring. Birinchi gap: hozir kimsiz yoki nima bilan shug‘ullanasiz. Ikkinchi: nimani o‘qigansiz yoki qayerda ishlagansiz, o‘tgan zamonda. Uchinchi: qanday lavozim qidiryapsiz. Agar ishlamasangiz, talaba bo‘lib ham javob bera olasiz. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Introduce yourself in three sentences. Who are you now? What did you study or do? What job are you looking for?
scenes.say_uz: O‘zingizni uchta gapda tanishtiring. Hozir kimsiz? Nimani o‘qigansiz yoki nima qilgansiz? Qanday ish qidiryapsiz?

scenes.title: Namuna
board: I'm a recent graduate in marketing.
I studied at WIUT and did an internship at a local company.
I'm looking for a junior marketing position.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “I’m a recent graduate in marketing. I studied at university in Tashkent and did an internship at a local company. Now I’m looking for a junior marketing position.” Ko‘rdingizmi, bu yerda hozirgi zamon, o‘tgan zamon va “looking for” bor. Sizniki boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi tartib. Agar uchta qism bor bo‘lsa, javobingiz yaxshi.
scenes.say: I'm a recent graduate in marketing. I studied at university and did an internship at a local company. Now I'm looking for a junior marketing position.
scenes.say_uz: Men marketing bo‘yicha yaqinda bitirgan mutaxassisman. Universitetda o‘qiganman va mahalliy kompaniyada amaliyot o‘tganman. Hozir kichik marketing lavozimini qidiryapman.

scenes.title: Nega aynan bu ish?
board: Why do you want this job?

examples.t: I'm interested in this role because it uses my language skills.
examples.uz: Bu lavozim tillar bilimimdan foydalangani uchun qiziqtiradi.

examples.t: I'd like the opportunity to learn from an experienced team.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi klassik savol: “Why do you want this job?”. Yaxshi javob uchta narsani o‘z ichiga oladi: ish yoki kompaniyaga qiziqish, sizning tajribangiz bunga mos kelishi va nimani o‘rganmoqchi ekaningiz. Kalit iboralar: “I’m interested in”, “I’d like the opportunity to”. Kechagi darsdagidek “because” bilan sabab keltiring. “Because I need money” deb javob bermang, bu rost bo‘lsa ham ish beruvchiga yoqmaydi.
scenes.say: Why do you want this job? I'm interested in this role because it uses my language skills. I'd like the opportunity to learn from an experienced team.
scenes.say_uz: Nega bu ishni xohlaysiz? Bu lavozim tillar bilimimdan foydalangani uchun qiziqtiradi. Tajribali jamoadan o‘rganish imkoniyatini xohlayman.

scenes.title: Nega sizni olishimiz kerak?
board: I have the skills you need.
I'm a quick learner and a team player.
I can bring… to the team.

examples.t: I have the skills you need, and I learn quickly.
examples.uz: Menda sizga kerak ko‘nikmalar bor va tez o‘rganaman.

examples.t: I can bring fresh ideas to the team.
examples.uz: Jamoaga yangi g‘oyalar olib kela olaman.

scenes.say_native: Bu savol qo‘pol tuyulishi mumkin, ammo aslida u sizga o‘zingizni sotish imkonini beradi. Maqtanmasdan, aniq bo‘ling: “I have the skills you need”, “I’m a quick learner”, “I can bring fresh ideas to the team”. Har gapdan keyin qisqa dalil qo‘shing. Masalan, “I’m a quick learner. In my last job, I learned the new system in a week.” Dalilsiz so‘zlar ishonarli emas, dalil bilan esa kuchli eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Why should we hire you? I have the skills you need, and I learn quickly. In my last job, I learned the new system in a week.
scenes.say_uz: Nega sizni ishga olishimiz kerak? Menda kerakli ko‘nikmalar bor va tez o‘rganaman. Oxirgi ishimda yangi tizimni bir haftada o‘rgandim.

scenes.title: Kuchli tomonlar: sifatlar
board: a good communicator · a team player

examples.t: I'm very organised and I meet deadlines.
examples.uz: Men juda tartibliman va muddatlarga ulguraman.

examples.t: I'm good at solving problems.

scenes.say_native: Kuchli tomonlarni aytish uchun sifatlar kerak: “reliable” ishonchli, “organised” tartibli, “flexible” moslashuvchan, “hard-working” mehnatsevar, “creative” ijodkor. Yana “a good communicator” va “a team player”. “Good at” dan keyin fe’lning -ing shakli keladi: “good at solving problems”. Britaniya imlosida “organised”, amerikacha “organized”. Faqat sifatni aytish yetarli emas, albatta misol ham keltiring.
scenes.say: Useful strengths: reliable, organised, flexible, hard-working, creative. I'm very organised and I meet deadlines. I'm good at solving problems.
scenes.say_uz: Foydali kuchli tomonlar: ishonchli, tartibli, moslashuvchan, mehnatsevar, ijodkor. Men juda tartibliman va muddatlarga ulguraman. Muammolarni yechishga qobiliyatliman.

scenes.title: Kuchli tomon + dalil
board: I'm reliable. I haven't missed a day in two years.
I'm a team player. We finished the project early.

examples.t: I'm reliable. I haven't missed a day of work in two years.
examples.uz: Men ishonchliman. Ikki yil ichida bitta ham ish kunini o‘tkazib yubormaganman.

examples.t: I led a small team and we finished the project early.
examples.uz: Kichik guruhga boshchilik qildim va loyihani muddatdan oldin tugatdik.

scenes.say_native: Eng yaxshi javob qolipi: kuchli tomon, keyin misol, keyin natija. “I’m reliable” bu da’vo. “I haven’t missed a day of work in two years” bu dalil. Yoki: “I led a small team and we finished the project early”. Dalilda hozirgi tugallangan zamon yoki o‘tgan oddiy zamonni ishlating. Faqat rost narsani ayting: suhbatda savollar ko‘payganda to‘qima fosh bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Give a strength, then an example. I'm reliable. I haven't missed a day of work in two years. I led a small team, and we finished the project early.
scenes.say_uz: Kuchli tomonni ayting, keyin misol keltiring. Men ishonchliman. Ikki yil ichida bitta ham kunni o‘tkazib yubormaganman. Kichik guruhga boshchilik qildim va loyihani muddatdan oldin tugatdik.

scenes.title: Zaif tomonlar haqida
board: Real, small weakness + what you do
I used to find… but now I…

examples.t: I sometimes spend too long on details, so I now set time limits.
examples.uz: Ba’zan tafsilotlarga ko‘p vaqt sarflayman, shuning uchun hozir vaqt chegarasi qo‘yaman.

examples.t: I'm working on my public speaking.

scenes.say_native: “What is your weakness?” savolidan qo‘rqmang. Maqsad sizni yo‘qotish emas, o‘zingizni bilishingizni ko‘rsatish. Qoida: haqiqiy, lekin ishga halaqit bermaydigan kichik kamchilikni ayting va uni qanday yaxshilayotganingizni qo‘shing. “I’m working on my public speaking” yoki “I used to find presentations difficult, but now I practise every week”. “I have no weaknesses” deb javob bermang, bu ishonchsiz eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Choose a real but small weakness and say what you are doing about it. I'm working on my public speaking. I sometimes spend too long on details, so I now set time limits.
scenes.say_uz: Haqiqiy, lekin kichik kamchilikni tanlang va u bilan nima qilayotganingizni ayting. Ommaviy nutq ustida ishlayapman. Ba’zan tafsilotlarga ko‘p vaqt ketkazaman, shuning uchun vaqt chegarasi qo‘yaman.

scenes.title: Tipik grammatik xatolar
board: ✓ I have a lot of experience.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi “good in”, to‘g‘risi “good at”. Ikkinchisi: “a big experience”. O‘zbekchada “katta tajriba” deymiz, lekin inglizchada “experience” bu ma’noda sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun artikl va ko‘plik yo‘q: “a lot of experience”, “five years of experience”. Faqat konkret voqea ma’nosida sanaladi: “It was a great experience”. Yana bir xato: “I am hard-worker”. To‘g‘risi: “I am hard-working” yoki “I am a hard worker”.
scenes.say: Say good at, not good in. Say a lot of experience, not a big experience. And say hard-working or a hard worker.
scenes.say_uz: Good at deng, good in emas. A lot of experience deng, a big experience emas. Hard-working yoki a hard worker deng.

scenes.title: Kuchli tomon va dalil
board: Mention one weakness + what you do
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz urinib ko‘ring. Bitta kuchli tomonni tanlang, masalan ishonchli yoki tartibli. Ayting: “I’m …” va unga bitta misol qo‘shing. Keyin bitta kichik kamchilikni ayting va uni yaxshilash uchun nima qilayotganingizni qo‘shing. Jami to‘rt gap. Ish tajribangiz bo‘lmasa, o‘qish yoki uy hayotidan misol keltiring.
scenes.say: Say one strength with an example. Then say one small weakness and what you are doing about it.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta kuchli tomonni misol bilan ayting. Keyin bitta kichik kamchilikni va u bilan nima qilayotganingizni ayting.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: I'm very organised. I plan my week every Sunday.
I sometimes find it hard to say no, so I'm learning to set priorities.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: “I’m very organised. I plan my week every Sunday, and I have never missed a deadline at university. My weakness is that I sometimes find it hard to say no, so I’m learning to set priorities.” Bu yerda kuchli tomon dalil bilan keldi, kamchilik esa yechim bilan. Sizning javobingizda ham mana shu ikki element bormi? Bo‘lsa, siz tayyor javobga yaqinsiz.
scenes.say: I'm very organised. I plan my week every Sunday, and I have never missed a deadline. My weakness is that I find it hard to say no, so I'm learning to set priorities.
scenes.say_uz: Men juda tartibliman. Haftamni har yakshanba rejalashtiraman va hech qachon muddatni o‘tkazib yubormaganman. Kamchiligim shuki, yo‘q deyish qiyin, shuning uchun ustuvorliklarni belgilashni o‘rganyapman.

scenes.title: Tajriba: o‘tgan zamon va present perfect
board: Past simple: finished time → I worked at ABC from 2019 to 2022.
Present perfect: still / experience → I've worked there for three years.

examples.t: I worked at a bank from 2019 to 2022.
I've worked as a teacher for five years.
examples.uz: Besh yildan beri o‘qituvchi bo‘lib ishlayman.

examples.t: I've been in this job since 2021.

scenes.say_native: Tajribani tasvirlashda ikkita zamon asosiy. Tugagan davr uchun o‘tgan oddiy zamon: “I worked at a bank from 2019 to 2022”. Hali davom etayotgan ish uchun hozirgi tugallangan zamon: “I’ve worked as a teacher for five years”. “For” davomiylikni ko‘rsatadi, “since” boshlanish nuqtasini: “since 2021”. O‘zbekchada ikkalasi ham “ishlaganman” yoki “ishlayman” bo‘lishi mumkin, inglizchada esa zamon aniq tanlanadi.
scenes.say: For a finished job, use the past simple: I worked at a bank from 2019 to 2022. For a job that continues, use the present perfect: I've worked as a teacher for five years. I've been here since 2021.
scenes.say_uz: Tugagan ish uchun o‘tgan oddiy zamon: 2019 dan 2022 gacha bankda ishlaganman. Davom etayotgan ish uchun hozirgi tugallangan zamon: besh yildan beri o‘qituvchi bo‘lib ishlayman. 2021-yildan beri shu yerdaman.

scenes.title: Mas’uliyatlarni tasvirlash

examples.t: I was responsible for the daily reports.
examples.uz: Kunlik hisobotlar uchun men mas’ul edim.

examples.t: I trained two new colleagues.

scenes.say_native: Ishdagi vazifalaringizni aytish uchun yaxshi fe’llar bor: “managed” boshqargan, “organised” tashkil qilgan, “trained” o‘rgatgan, “developed” rivojlantirgan, “dealt with” bilan ishlagan. Iboralar: “I was responsible for” va “My main duties included”. “Responsible for” dan keyin ot yoki -ing shakli keladi: “responsible for managing the website”. Imkon bo‘lsa, raqam qo‘shing: “I dealt with about thirty customers a day”.
scenes.say: I was responsible for the daily reports. I trained two new colleagues. I dealt with about thirty customers a day.
scenes.say_uz: Kunlik hisobotlar uchun men mas’ul edim. Ikkita yangi hamkasbni o‘rgatdim. Kuniga taxminan o‘ttiz mijoz bilan ishlardim.

scenes.title: Zamon va predlog xatolari
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: “I work here since 2019”. “Since” bilan hozirgi oddiy zamon ishlatilmaydi, hozirgi tugallangan zamon kerak: “I’ve worked here since 2019”. O‘zbekchada “2019 dan beri ishlayman” deymiz, shuning uchun xato qilinadi. Ikkinchisi: aniq o‘tgan vaqt bilan, “in 2019”, present perfect emas, o‘tgan oddiy zamon: “I worked there in 2019”. Uchinchisi: “responsible for”, “of” emas.
scenes.say: With since, use the present perfect: I've worked here since 2019. With a finished time like in 2019, use the past simple: I worked there in 2019. And say responsible for.
scenes.say_uz: Since bilan hozirgi tugallangan zamon ishlating: 2019 dan beri shu yerda ishlayman. In 2019 kabi aniq o‘tgan vaqt bilan o‘tgan oddiy zamon. Va responsible for deng.

scenes.title: Zamonni tanlang
board: 3) I (be) a manager for two years now.
scenes.say_native: Qavs ichidagi fe’lni to‘g‘ri shaklga qo‘ying. Birinchi: “I work here since 2020”. Ikkinchi: “I work at a shop in 2018”. Uchinchi: “I be a manager for two years now”. Har bir gapda “since”, “in 2018” va “for” ko‘rsatkichlariga qarab zamonni tanlang. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: One: I work here since 2020. Two: I work at a shop in 2018. Three: I be a manager for two years now. Fix each sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: I work here since 2020. Ikkinchi: I work at a shop in 2018. Uchinchi: I be a manager for two years now. Har birini to‘g‘rilang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) I worked at a shop in 2018.
3) I've been a manager for two years.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, “I’ve worked here since 2020”, chunki “since” va ish hozir ham davom etyapti. Ikkinchi, “I worked at a shop in 2018”: aniq o‘tgan yil, shuning uchun o‘tgan oddiy zamon. Uchinchi, “I’ve been a manager for two years”: “be” ning hozirgi tugallangan shakli “have been”. Suhbatda aynan shu uch qolip eng ko‘p kerak bo‘ladi, shuning uchun ularni yodlab oling.
scenes.say: One: I've worked here since 2020. Two: I worked at a shop in 2018. Three: I've been a manager for two years.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: 2020 dan beri shu yerda ishlayman. Ikkinchi: 2018-yilda do‘konda ishlaganman. Uchinchi: ikki yildan beri menejerman.

scenes.title: Rasmiy uslub
board: Don't use slang: yeah, nope, guys
Use full forms when you can: I would like…
Polite: Could you repeat that, please?

examples.t: Could you repeat the question, please?
I would like to explain.

scenes.say_native: Suhbat rasmiy vaziyat, shuning uchun uslubni moslang. “Yeah” o‘rniga “yes”, “nope” o‘rniga “no”, “guys” o‘rniga ismlarni ishlating. Qisqartmalar masalan “I’m” va “I’ve” aytishga yo‘l qo‘yiladi, lekin “gonna” va “wanna” ishlatmang. Savolni tushunmasangiz, uyalmang: “Could you repeat the question, please?”. Bu muloyim eshitiladi. Ingliz tilida “could” va “would” ni ishlatish odobni bildiradi.
scenes.say: Use formal language. Say yes, not yeah. Say going to, not gonna. If you didn't understand, say: Could you repeat the question, please?
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy tilni ishlating. Yeah emas, yes deng. Gonna emas, going to deng. Tushunmasangiz: Savolni takrorlay olasizmi? deng.

scenes.title: Norasmiy va rasmiy
board: get a job → obtain a position
a lot of → a great deal of / many
bad at → not very strong in
scenes.say_native: Mana norasmiy va rasmiyroq variantlar. “I want” o‘rniga “I would like”. “A lot of” o‘rniga ba’zan “a great deal of”. “Get a job” o‘rniga “find a position”. “Sorry?” o‘rniga “Pardon?” yoki “Could you say that again?”. Hamma narsani murakkablashtirish shart emas: B1 darajasida oddiy va aniq rasmiy gap eng yaxshi. “I would like to work here” ishonchli eshitiladi, “I want to work here” esa biroz to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: Compare. I want a job. I would like a position. Sorry? Could you say that again? A lot of experience. A great deal of experience.
scenes.say_uz: Taqqoslang. Men ish xohlayman. Men lavozimni xohlardim. Nima? Yana bir marta ayta olasizmi? Ko‘p tajriba. Katta tajriba.

scenes.title: Suhbatda aytilmaydigan gaplar
scenes.say_native: Ikki juda keng tarqalgan xato. Birinchisi: norasmiy so‘zlar, “yeah”, “no problem”, “whatever”. Ularning o‘rniga “Yes, certainly” yoki “Of course”. Ikkinchisi: oldingi ish joyi yoki rahbar haqida salbiy gapirish. “I hate my old boss” deb aytsangiz, kelajakda sizning ham shunday gapirishingizni o‘ylashadi. Shunday ekan, ishdan ketish sababini ijobiy ifodalang: “I wanted a new challenge” yoki “I was looking for more opportunities to grow”.
scenes.say: Don't say yeah or whatever. Say yes, certainly. And never criticise your old boss. Say: I wanted a new challenge.
scenes.say_uz: Yeah yoki whatever demang. Yes, certainly deng. Oldingi rahbaringizni hech qachon tanqid qilmang. Ayting: yangi qiyinchilik xohlagandim.

scenes.title: Rasmiy qiling
board: 3) My last boss was awful, so I left.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni rasmiy suhbatga mos qilib qayta ayting. Birinchi: “Yeah, I wanna work here”. Ikkinchi: “Sorry? Say it again!”. Uchinchi: “My last boss was awful, so I left”. Uchinchisini ijobiy sababga aylantiring. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: One: Yeah, I wanna work here. Two: Sorry? Say it again! Three: My last boss was awful, so I left. Make each one suitable for an interview.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Ha, men bu yerda ishlamoqchiman. Ikkinchi: Nima? Yana ayt! Uchinchi: Oldingi rahbarim dahshat edi, shuning uchun ketdim. Har birini suhbatga mos qiling.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Yes, I would like to work here.
3) I wanted a new challenge, so I left.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, “Yes, I would like to work here”. Ikkinchi, “Could you repeat that, please?”. Uchinchi, “I wanted a new challenge, so I left”. Ko‘rdingizmi, ma’no saqlanadi, lekin ohang muloyim va professional bo‘ladi. Rasmiy uslub tilni murakkablashtirish emas, balki ehtiyotkor va hurmatli tanlash.
scenes.say: One: Yes, I would like to work here. Two: Could you repeat that, please? Three: I wanted a new challenge, so I left.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Ha, bu yerda ishlashni xohlardim. Ikkinchi: Takrorlay olasizmi? Uchinchi: Yangi qiyinchilik xohlagandim, shuning uchun ketdim.

scenes.title: Dialog: birinchi suhbat
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Menejer Ms Clark nomzod Dilshod bilan suhbatlashmoqda. Savollar: Dilshodning kasbi nima, qancha tajribasi bor va asosiy kuchli tomoni nima? Dilshod qanday rasmiy iboralarni ishlatayotganiga ham e’tibor bering. Tinglagandan so‘ng savollarga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Ms Clark: Good morning, Dilshod. Thank you for coming. Could you tell me about yourself? Dilshod: Certainly. I'm a web developer with four years of experience. I've worked at a software company since 2021. Ms Clark: And what is your biggest strength? Dilshod: I'm a quick learner. I would like to use that to grow in your team.
scenes.say_uz: Ms Clark: Xayrli tong, Dilshod. Kelganingiz uchun rahmat. O‘zingiz haqingizda aytib bera olasizmi? Dilshod: Albatta. Men to‘rt yillik tajribali veb-dasturchiman. 2021-yildan beri dasturiy ta’minot kompaniyasida ishlayman. Ms Clark: Eng kuchli tomoningiz nima? Dilshod: Tez o‘rganaman. Buni sizning jamoangizda o‘sish uchun ishlatmoqchiman.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 2) How long has he worked at his company?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: Dilshodning kasbi nima? Ikkinchi: u hozirgi kompaniyada qachondan beri ishlaydi? Uchinchi: uning kuchli tomoni nima? To‘liq gap bilan javob bering va zamonni to‘g‘ri tanlang: ikkinchi javobda “since” bor.
scenes.say: One: What is Dilshod's job? Two: How long has he worked at his company? Three: What is his strength?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Dilshodning kasbi nima? Ikkinchi: U kompaniyada qachondan beri ishlaydi? Uchinchi: Uning kuchli tomoni nima?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, Dilshod veb-dasturchi. Ikkinchi, “He has worked there since 2021”, hozirgi tugallangan zamon va “since”. Uchinchi, uning kuchli tomoni: tez o‘rganadi. Dilshod savolni tinglab, aniq javob berdi, “certainly” deb muloyim boshladi va oxirida kelajak maqsadini qo‘shdi. Mana shu yaxshi javob tuzilmasi.
scenes.say: One: He is a web developer. Two: He has worked there since 2021. Three: He is a quick learner.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: U veb-dasturchi. Ikkinchi: U 2021-yildan beri o‘sha yerda ishlaydi. Uchinchi: U tez o‘rganadi.

scenes.title: Suhbatchiga savollar berish
board: Do you have any questions for us?
What does a typical day look like?
What are the opportunities for training?

examples.t: What would a typical day in this role look like?
examples.uz: Bu lavozimda odatiy kun qanday o‘tadi?

examples.t: What are the next steps in the process?

scenes.say_native: Suhbat oxirida deyarli har doim so‘rashadi: “Do you have any questions for us?”. “No” deb javob berish zaif taassurot qoldiradi. Tayyorlab boring! Yaxshi savollar: “What would a typical day look like?”, “What are the opportunities for training?”, “What are the next steps?”. Bular sizning ishga qiziqishingizni ko‘rsatadi. Savol berish ham fikrlashingizni ko‘rsatadigan imkoniyat. Ikki-uch savol tayyorlang.
scenes.say: Do you have any questions? Yes, I do. What would a typical day look like? What are the opportunities for training? What are the next steps?
scenes.say_uz: Savollaringiz bormi? Ha. Odatiy kun qanday o‘tadi? O‘qish imkoniyatlari qanday? Keyingi bosqichlar qanday?

scenes.title: Savollardagi xatolar
board: ✗ How much money will I get?  (birinchi savol)
✓ What are the opportunities for growth?
✗ What does your company do? (saytdan o‘qish mumkin)
✗ What time you start? → ✓ What time do you start?
scenes.say_native: Bu bosqichda ham xato bor. Birinchisi: suhbat boshida yoki birinchi savol sifatida maosh va ta’tilni so‘rash. Bu ishni emas, faqat pulni o‘ylayotganingizni ko‘rsatadi. Maosh haqida odatda ish beruvchi o‘zi gapiradi. Ikkinchisi: kompaniya sayti va ochiq ma’lumotlarda bor narsani so‘rash. Oldindan o‘qib keling. Uchinchisi: grammatik xato, “What time you start?”. Savolda yordamchi fe’l kerak: “What time do you start?”.
scenes.say: Don't ask about money first. Don't ask what the company does. Do your research. And use do in questions: What time do you start?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi bo‘lib maosh haqida so‘ramang. Kompaniya nima qilishini so‘ramang, oldindan o‘qib keling. Va savolda do ishlating: Soat nechada boshlaysiz?

scenes.title: Savol tuzing
scenes.say_native: Uchta mavzu bo‘yicha savol tuzing. Birinchi: bu lavozimdagi odatiy kun. Ikkinchi: o‘qish va rivojlanish imkoniyatlari. Uchinchi: keyingi bosqichlar. Har birini muloyim va to‘liq savol shaklida ayting. Masalan, “Could you tell me…” bilan boshlasangiz ham bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Make three polite questions about: the typical day, training opportunities, and the next steps.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta muloyim savol tuzing: odatiy kun, o‘qish imkoniyatlari va keyingi bosqichlar haqida.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) What would a typical day look like?
3) Could you tell me about the next steps?
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy savollar: birinchi, “What would a typical day look like in this role?”. Ikkinchi, “What training opportunities are there?”. Uchinchi, “Could you tell me about the next steps?”. Oxirgisida “Could you tell me” dan keyin odatiy tartib qaytadi, ya’ni “about the next steps” deyiladi. Sizning savollaringiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, aniq va muloyim bo‘lsa yetarli.
scenes.say: One: What would a typical day look like in this role? Two: What training opportunities are there? Three: Could you tell me about the next steps?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Bu lavozimda odatiy kun qanday o‘tadi? Ikkinchi: Qanday o‘qish imkoniyatlari bor? Uchinchi: Keyingi bosqichlar haqida aytib bera olasizmi?

scenes.title: Dialog: suhbat oxiri
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog suhbatning oxiri. Nomzod Madina savol beradi va suhbatni muloyim tugatadi. Savollar: Madina nima haqida so‘radi va qachon javob olishadi? Uning rahmat aytish iboralariga ham e’tibor bering. Shunday xayrlashuv suhbatning oxirgi taassurotini yaxshilaydi.
scenes.say: Mr Hill: Do you have any questions for us? Madina: Yes, thank you. Could you tell me what training is offered? Mr Hill: Of course. New staff have a two-week programme. Madina: That sounds excellent. When will I hear from you? Mr Hill: We'll contact you next week. Madina: Thank you very much for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.
scenes.say_uz: Mr Hill: Savollaringiz bormi? Madina: Ha, rahmat. Qanday o‘qish taklif qilinishini ayta olasizmi? Mr Hill: Albatta. Yangi xodimlar uchun ikki haftalik dastur bor. Madina: Bu a’lo eshitiladi. Siz bilan qachon aloqa bo‘ladi? Mr Hill: Kelasi hafta bog‘lanamiz. Madina: Vaqtingiz uchun katta rahmat. Javobingizni kutaman.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: Madina nima haqida so‘radi? Ikkinchi: dastur qancha davom etadi? Uchinchi: ular Madina bilan qachon bog‘lanadi? To‘liq gapda javob bering. Esingizda bo‘lsin, yakunda “look forward to hearing from you” iborasi ishlatildi.
scenes.say: One: What does Madina ask about? Two: How long is the programme? Three: When will they contact her?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Madina nima haqida so‘radi? Ikkinchi: Dastur qancha davom etadi? Uchinchi: Unga qachon bog‘lanishadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) They will contact her next week.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, Madina o‘qish yoki trening haqida so‘radi. Ikkinchi, dastur ikki hafta davom etadi. Uchinchi, ular kelasi hafta bog‘lanadi. Madina oxirida “Thank you very much for your time” va “I look forward to hearing from you” dedi. Bu ikki ibora suhbatni chiroyli yakunlaydi. “Look forward to” dan keyin fe’lning -ing shakli keladi, “hearing”.
scenes.say: One: She asks about training. Two: It lasts two weeks. Three: They will contact her next week.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: U trening haqida so‘raydi. Ikkinchi: U ikki hafta davom etadi. Uchinchi: Unga kelasi hafta bog‘lanishadi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: urg‘u va ohang
scenes.say_native: Suhbatda aniq talaffuz ishonchni oshiradi. So‘z urg‘usi: “interview” da birinchi bo‘g‘in, ya’ni “IN-ter-view”. “Experience” da ikkinchi: “ex-PE-ri-ence”. “Responsible” ham ikkinchi: “re-SPON-si-ble”. “Career” da ham ikkinchi bo‘g‘in: “ka-REER”. Ohangda esa darak gapni pasayuvchi tonda ayting, bu ishonchli eshitiladi. Sekin va aniq gapiring: tez gapirish asabiylik belgisi bo‘lishi mumkin.
scenes.say: Word stress matters. Interview, with stress on the first part. Experience, with stress on the second. Responsible. Career. Speak clearly and not too fast.
scenes.say_uz: So‘z urg‘usi muhim. Interview, birinchi qismda urg‘u. Experience, ikkinchisida. Responsible. Career. Aniq va juda tez bo‘lmagan holda gapiring.

scenes.title: Urg‘u bilan ayting
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta so‘zni to‘g‘ri urg‘u bilan ayting. Avval “interview”, birinchi bo‘g‘inga urg‘u. Keyin “experience”, “responsible” va “career”, ularda ikkinchi bo‘g‘in kuchli. Keyin to‘liq gapda ayting: “I have experience in this career”. Ikki marta takrorlang.
scenes.say: Interview. Experience. Responsible. Career. I am responsible for the interview.
scenes.say_uz: Interview. Experience. Responsible. Career. Suhbat uchun men mas’ulman.

scenes.title: Tekshiruv
scenes.say_native: Tekshiramiz. “Interview” da urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda, “exPErience” da ikkinchisida, “reSPONsible” da ikkinchisida va “caREER” da ham ikkinchisida. Ko‘p o‘zbek o‘quvchilar “interVIEW” deb aytadi, chunki so‘zning oxiriga urg‘u berish o‘zbekchada ko‘p uchraydi. Shuning uchun inglizchada so‘zni boshidan tinglashga odatlaning.
scenes.say: Interview, stress on the first part. Experience, stress on the second. Responsible, stress on the second. Career, stress on the second.
scenes.say_uz: Interview, urg‘u birinchisida. Experience, ikkinchisida. Responsible, ikkinchisida. Career, ikkinchisida.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: 5 savolga javob
board: 2) Why do you want this job?
scenes.say_native: Endi to‘liq mashq. Beshta savolga ovoz chiqarib javob bering. Birinchi: o‘zingiz haqingizda. Ikkinchi: nega bu ish. Uchinchi: kuchli tomonlaringiz. To‘rtinchi: tajribangiz. Beshinchi: o‘z savolingiz. Har biriga kamida ikki gap ayting. Rasmiy, aniq va xotirjam gapiring.
scenes.say: Answer these five questions aloud. Tell me about yourself. Why do you want this job? What are your strengths? Tell me about your experience. Do you have any questions?
scenes.say_uz: Beshta savolga ovoz chiqarib javob bering. O‘zingiz haqingizda ayting. Nega bu ishni xohlaysiz? Kuchli tomonlaringiz? Tajribangiz? Savollaringiz bormi?

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: I'm interested in this role because…
Could you tell me about training?
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob qismlari. “I’m a recent marketing graduate and I did an internship at a local company.” “I’m interested in this role because it combines creativity and data.” “I’m reliable: I have never missed a deadline.” “I’ve worked on three campaigns.” “Could you tell me about training opportunities?” Ko‘rdingizmi, har javob qisqa, aniq va dalilli. Uy vazifasida aynan shu uslubni takrorlaysiz.
scenes.say: I'm a recent marketing graduate. I'm interested in this role because it combines creativity and data. I'm reliable: I have never missed a deadline. Could you tell me about training opportunities?
scenes.say_uz: Men marketing bo‘yicha yaqinda bitirgan mutaxassisman. Bu lavozim ijodkorlik va ma’lumotni birlashtirgani uchun qiziqtiradi. Men ishonchliman: hech qachon muddatni o‘tkazib yubormaganman. O‘qish imkoniyatlari haqida aytib bera olasizmi?

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Tell me about yourself: present · past · future
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. O‘zingiz haqingizda: hozir, o‘tmish va maqsad. Kuchli tomonni doim misol bilan ayting. Tajribada: tugagan ish uchun o‘tgan zamon, davom etayotgan ish uchun hozirgi tugallangan zamon, “since” va “for”. Rasmiy uslubda “yeah” va “gonna” dan qoching, oldingi rahbarni tanqid qilmang. Va oxirida kamida ikkita tayyor savol bering. Esda tuting: “good at”, “a lot of experience”, “responsible for”.
scenes.say: To sum up: introduce yourself with present, past and future. Support strengths with examples. Use the present perfect with since and for. Be formal and polite. And ask good questions.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: o‘zingizni hozir, o‘tmish va kelajak bilan tanishtiring. Kuchli tomonlarni misol bilan qo‘llab-quvvatlang. Since va for bilan hozirgi tugallangan zamonni ishlating. Rasmiy va muloyim bo‘ling. Yaxshi savollar bering.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: beshta suhbat savoliga ovoz chiqarib javob bering: o‘zingiz haqingizda, nega bu ish, kuchli tomonlar, tajriba va o‘zingizning savolingiz. O‘zingizni yozib oling. Mezon: har javob kamida ikki gap, kuchli tomonda misol bor, rasmiy uslub saqlangan, “good at” va “since” to‘g‘ri ishlatilgan. Keyingi darsda ta’lim va o‘qish mavzusini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: answer five interview questions aloud and record yourself. Check that you gave examples and used formal, polite English. Good luck, and see you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: beshta suhbat savoliga ovoz chiqarib javob bering va o‘zingizni yozib oling. Misollar keltirganingizni va rasmiy, muloyim ingliz tilidan foydalanganingizni tekshiring. Omad, keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Beshta suhbat savoliga ovoz chiqarib javob bering va yozib oling: Tell me about yourself; Why do you want this job; What are your strengths; Tell me about your experience; va o‘zingizning savolingiz. Mezon: har javob kamida 2 gap, kuchli tomonda misol bor, rasmiy uslub saqlangan, good at va since/for to‘g‘ri ishlatilgan.

quiz.q: I am very good ___ solving problems.
quiz.why_uz: Good at — qolip; undan keyin -ing shakli keladi.

options: I have a lot of experience.
I have many experiences in work.
quiz.why_uz: Experience bu ma’noda sanalmaydigan ot: a lot of experience.
Since bilan hozirgi tugallangan zamon: have worked.
Aniq o‘tgan vaqt (in 2018) bilan o‘tgan oddiy zamon.

quiz.q: Which answer is best for “Tell me about yourself”?
options: My name is Ali. I like football.
I'm an accountant with three years of experience, and I'm looking for a new challenge.
I don't know what to say.
quiz.why_uz: Kasbiy ma’lumot: hozir, o‘tmish va maqsad.

quiz.q: Which is more suitable for an interview?
Why did you leave your last job? Best answer:
I was responsible ___ the daily reports.

quiz.why_uz: Experience so‘zida urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: ex-PE-ri-ence.
